subject: Escalation: ingress parser timeouts degrading throughput for QuantifyAI
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@quantifyai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: sharp rise in inference errors and timeouts (QuantifyAI)

Rishi —

We started seeing a large spike in errors and timeouts hitting Redwood starting ~08:45 PST this morning. Symptoms:
- ~12% of streaming calls failing with 5xx & connection-level timeouts
- tail latency for successful streaming responses jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.2s
- overall throughput to our service dropped ~30% compared to baseline

We rolled back nothing on our side; the only change this week was upgrading our in-house client SDK to v1.14.2 (still using chunked transfer streaming). I attached a short log snippet showing repeated socket closes and a few request IDs: rq_20261005_19, rq_20261005_23.

Can you confirm whether something changed on the ingress parsing/stream handling side? This is impacting several customer-facing jobs.

Attaching: quantifyai_error_snippet.txt (excerpted logs)

—Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, QuantifyAI
sara.patel@quantifyai.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@quantifyai.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:49:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Production: sharp rise in inference errors and timeouts (QuantifyAI)

Forwarding initial findings from runtime:

Quick summary of what we see (INF-2376):
- Multiple streaming connections from QuantifyAI show the ingress parser throwing a "header reassembly timeout" when a small subset of requests arrive with chunked-trailer ordering different from the dominant pattern (rare but present).
- Parser failure path triggers connection tear-down which surfaces as 5xx for the client and increases perceived tail latency as clients retry.
- Correlation: nearly all affected connection traces are from SDK v1.14.2 and specifically when the client sends small initial header frames followed by out-of-order chunk metadata (edge-case in our streaming parser introduced during the 1.13->1.14 optimization).

Attachments: parser-trace-quantifyai.log (full trace for rq_20261005_19)

Immediate actions proposed:
- Short-term: route QuantifyAI traffic to the fallback parser in the next 15 minutes (non-breaking toggle) — should eliminate new parser-timeout-induced disconnects.
- Mid-term: patch parsing logic to accept the alternate ordering; target deploy in 48 hours with canary in prod.
- Communications: we should offer QuantifyAI a credit for the impacted window and a post-mortem when done.

I'm starting a ticket (INF-2376) and will add context. Jonas, can infra take the routing toggle? Rishi, I recommend we keep Sara updated every 2 hours until stable.

—Monica
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime Infra

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@quantifyai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+quantify@quantifyai.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: sharp rise in inference errors and timeouts (QuantifyAI)

Thanks — we can confirm the SDK is 1.14.2+build-7. We did begin a gradual rollout to our production cluster at 07:50 PST; by 08:40 traffic was at ~60% on the new binary. Full trace id for a failed request: rq_20261005_23.

We appreciate the routing toggle and the patch ETA, but AS the impact touched several live features, our CEO asked for an executive sync and an SLA credit discussion. Looping in our ops alias for visibility.

—Sara

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@quantifyai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: SDK ingress parser timeouts impacting QuantifyAI - exec attention

Grace / Marissa — bringing this to you for exec visibility and next-step approvals. Summary and proposed plan: 

Summary:
- Root cause: client SDK (v1.14.2) exercised a parser ordering edge-case introduced in our recent optimization; our ingress parser has a stricter reassembly timeout for unexpected chunk ordering.
- Impact window: 2026-10-05 07:50–10:15 PST; QuantifyAI experienced ~12% request errors and a ~30% throughput drop.
- Affected customer: QuantifyAI (production); Tier: Enterprise (reserved capacity). Deal: D-48291.

Proposed immediate actions (already in flight):
1) We toggled QuantifyAI to the fallback parser at 09:05 PST on 2026-10-05 — mitigated new failures.
2) Infra will deploy a hotfix that relaxes reassembly ordering rules and adds defensive guards by 2026-10-07 20:00 PST (target).
3) Post-deploy: canary for 2 hours then global roll.
4) Offer QuantifyAI a credit for impacted window and provide a written post-mortem within 5 business days.

Requesting approvals: 
- OK to finalize the customer credit with Finance (estimate: two days of usage credit)
- Official exec sync: propose Thu 2026-10-08 10:00 PST (30 minutes) with Sara and their leadership — can you confirm availability?

Sara — apologies again for the disruption. We'll keep this channel updated and attach the post-mortem/doc artifacts to the Jira ticket. Linking INF-2376 and the drive folder with traces.

Attachments: mitigation-checklist.md

—Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
